annotations.text:
1200×630 is the size WhatsApp, Slack and X all crop from.
Everything load-bearing sits left of 720px so the diya can crop away without losing the message.

The ritual name and the detail line are editable — set them per page from generateMetadata().
Photo is the real satyanarayan-puja.jpg already in public/images/rituals.

One decision to make here: keep ॐ, or move to the diya.
ॐ is what the nav already uses. The diya is the one that still reads at 16px in a browser tab.
